places-tejera-cueva-del-nino.story: 351 km from Vélez-Blanco to Vélez-Blanco, about 6 h 03 of riding. The stops in between: Abrigo de la fuente, Andragulla I, Cueva del Gitano and Cueva del Niño. The highest point is about 1,400 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
